name: Standard-wise Subject Maximum Marks Fix
releaseNote: Fixed Result View/Print, Result Analysis, and Standard-wise Result Register to display generated Seat No. instead of Roll No. where available, with fallback to stored Seat No. and then Roll No.
notes: Standard 9=50, Standard 10=80, Standard 11=50, Standard 12=100 marks per subject consistently across marks entry, result view/print, analysis and standard-wise result register.
